title: mlops.drift-detected.v1 event body
description: Note where the contract actually lives: the consuming control plane reads metric_name, reference_value, current_value, relative_delta_pct and threshold_pct out of METRICS, not payload. A schema that only covered payload would leave the load-bearing half unvalidated.

reference_value.description: Nullable: a baseline window with no observations has no reference value, and the consumer renders that case rather than failing on it.

relative_delta_pct.description: Nullable for the same reason as reference_value: with no baseline there is no relative delta to compute.

window.description: Half-open observation window, ISO-8601. Emitted as strings by the producer, so validated as strings here rather than as a richer type the wire does not carry.
